case: A run that closes with both counts recorded and a divergence, which must be accepted rather than refused.
why: The comparison RECORDS the divergence; it does not require the two numbers to be equal. A procedure that checkpoints at every step boundary makes more launches than one that does not, and a run that reports honestly that it made more is the case the instrument exists to see -- refusing it would make the instrument something people route around. The patch hardens the guard by also demanding the causal episode that carries the allowance, which every closing run names.
